hardware: Apple M2 Pro, 10 logical cores, 16 GiB RAM
method: Fresh launches with separate default profiles on the built-in Retina panel at 1512 x 982 points, 2x backing scale. Grouped Processes page, Name ascending, Normal 500 ms refresh, 1120 x 720-point window. Each launch warmed for 60 s, then Scripts/MeasureProcess.c took 20 consecutive one-second proc_pid_rusage measurements. CPU is user plus system time divided by elapsed time as a percentage of one logical core. RSS and physical footprint are reported in MiB. A window observer checked stacking, overlap, foreground and minimized state 61 times during warm-up and 22 times around measurement. Additional applications were running. Screen capture and memory profiling began after the resource interval. A six-second, window-only, cursor-free capture sampled at up to 8 frames/s and recorded changes to the pixel hash. Median intervals exclude the initial image.

historical_warmed_reference.condition: A separate earlier 60-second warm-up in benchmarks/500ms-efficiency.json. This value is the memory target, not the contemporaneous physical-display control.
